reviews.text: I entrusted my two dogs to Francesca for my wedding day and I have to say thank you so much... it was the first time I left them with someone in ten years of their lives and I was a little scared, but instead everything went great, she proved to be understanding, attentive as well as professional and above all available, she was a great help on a very busy day and my dogs thank me so I highly recommend her, thanks again Francy ❤️

I couldn't have asked for anything better for my dog! Francesca cared for him for 10 days with incredible love and dedication. She kept me updated with photos and videos on Instagram every day, allowing me to enjoy my vacation with complete peace of mind. When I returned, I found a happy, calm, and super pampered dog. Highly recommended; she's become our go-to dog!
A thousand thanks!

Our dog Mia stayed with Francesca for three days in mid-August. When we returned from Calabria, Mia was very cheerful and lively. I can now say that our dog feels safe with her, and I can place my complete trust in Francesca for the future. Mia also has so much fun with the other dogs, especially Dylan and Orso. Thank you again, and best regards!
I've known Francesca for several years, and she's always a reliable source. My puppy was practically on vacation. A trustworthy choice.

I left my dogs with Francesca for 9 days because I couldn't take them with me. At first, I was a little worried, having never left them before. I was afraid they'd feel abandoned, but Francesca was exceptional. She pampered them and treated them with love and kindness. They got along great with the other dogs, too, and when I picked them up, they were truly calm and happy. Highly recommended ❤️

I entrusted my dog ​​Linda to their care for almost a month and couldn't be happier with my choice.
Since it was such a long period, my main concern was that she might suffer from loneliness, become disoriented, or change her habits. From the very first moment, however, the attention, kindness, and professionalism they showed me gave me great peace of mind.
The constant updates, photos, and videos I received during her stay allowed me to enjoy my vacation with complete peace of mind: it was clear how happy, pampered, and perfectly at ease Linda was. What I appreciated most was their ability to make her feel at home, respecting her time and giving her all the affection she needed.
Impeccable service and a rare humanity. I would entrust Linda to them again with my eyes closed and I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a completely trustworthy facility or person for their four-legged family member!
Francesca is professional, attentive to detail, and also friendly. Highly recommended.

It was a truly beautiful day! Even though there were only a few of us, there was a very pleasant and relaxed atmosphere. I really appreciated the simplicity and authenticity of the experience: a perfect way to experience the mountains with your dog. Congratulations on the passion you put into what you do; it really shows. I'll definitely be back!

It's always amusing to see how some "business" owners try, in vain, to defend the indefensible. A dog often has two owners, both of whom have the right to review a business.
The person in question refuses to accept dogs based solely on their breed, without evaluating a dog's temperament and training, and without an on-site assessment.
Having twenty years of experience with dogs of various sizes and breeds, I can assure you that a serious and, above all, qualified professional would not proceed in this way. Therefore, anyone who decides to entrust their pet to a center managed in this manner has the sacred right to know.
That said, I strongly recommend turning to serious professionals, not amateurs.

The review is clearly a retaliation for a refusal. This person has never been a client of mine; she was simply told that my facility wasn't suitable for her needs due to safety and pack management concerns. Being a professional also means knowing how to say no to protect the animals, even if some people balk at hearing that.

Serious, helpful, professional, knowledgeable, loving dog sitter... I have been entrusting my dogs (not so easy to manage) to her for many years and I have always found myself well, always safe when I am with her... highly recommended
Very positive experience!

I met Francesca because I was looking for someone to watch my Theodore for a weekend since I didn't have anyone nearby. From a simple one-night dog boarding experience, a relationship developed that we've now been pursuing for over a year. My Theodore enjoyed Francesca so much that I took him to her even when I didn't need it. I occasionally dropped him off at daycare while I was at work, and thanks to her, I've taken more weekend vacations because I know he's great with her. For longer vacations, however, we always take him with us. She's not just the person who watches your dog while you're on vacation; with her experience as a dog trainer, she's helped us correct some of our dog's "defects." Above all, thanks to socialization with other dogs, Theodore is much more sociable and outgoing, and his relationship with us owners is much more intense. I recommend Francesca to everyone, especially for the dog training programs we all need for our relationship with our dogs.
Theodore is now ready at the door when he hears Francesca's name, he is a happy dog ​​and it shows
